title: ShopNest — E-Commerce Platform
description: A full-featured e-commerce platform with product management, cart, checkout, Stripe payments, order tracking, and admin dashboard. Built with Next.js App Router and MongoDB.

title: DevCollab — Real-time Code Editor
description: A collaborative real-time code editor with syntax highlighting, multi-user cursors, room-based sessions, and live execution for 15+ programming languages via Judge0 API.

title: TaskFlow — Project Management App
description: A Trello-inspired project management app with drag-and-drop boards, task assignments, due dates, notifications, and team collaboration features.

title: NepalWeather — Weather Dashboard
description: A beautiful weather dashboard focused on Nepal featuring 7-day forecasts, hourly charts, air quality index, and interactive maps powered by OpenWeatherMap API.

title: CodeBlog — Developer Blog Platform
description: A developer-focused blogging platform with MDX support, syntax highlighting, full-text search, newsletter subscription, and SEO-optimized static generation.
